newsitem.title: FRANCE: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest - May 15.
newsitem.headline: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest - May 15.

text.p: REUTERS FRENCH ADVERTISING & MEDIA DIGEST
News from Reuters and the French press on Advertising, Marketing, Media, the Internet and Brand-name Products.
ADVERTISING & MARKETING:

MUNICH - International news and information organisation Reuters Holdings Plc and French media company Havas launch a data service for the advertising and media industry. The venture, Adways Data, offers companies information to help plan advertising campaigns in the media, Adways says. (Reuter)

PARIS - Havas Advertising says its first quarter turnover rose 17.4 percent to seven million francs ($1.2 million). At constant structure and exchange rates the rise was 7.1 percent, the company says. (Reuter)

LONDON - Kellogg Europe consolidates its media buying into a newly formed company that is part of J. Walter Thompson. Kellogg Europe, part of U.S.-based Kellogg Co, the world's largest cereal maker, previously bought its advertising space through six different companies but will now use just one company called Kellogg Europe Media. (Reuter)
PARIS - Publicis Conseil wins domestic appliance group Tefal's international budget in competition with Ogilvy & Mather, the favourite, and BDDP. (Le Figaro)
MEDIA & THE INTERNET:

PARIS - Television par Satellite (TPS), a French digital satellite television service operated by private TV station TF1, says it signed an exclusive deal to carry films made by U.S. producer Arnon Milchan's Regency Enterprises on its pay television service. (Reuter)

PARIS - French pay television group Canal Plus denies an Italian newspaper report that it is close to an accord over the stake held by German media magnate Leo Kirch in Italian pay TV firm Telepiu. (Reuter)
PARIS - Jet Multimedia, a French specialist in on-line services, aims to have net attributable profit of between 25 million and 30 million francs in 1998, says Chairman Eric Peyre. (Reuter) *********

PARIS - Shares in French special effects company Duran Duboi will be offered on the Paris bourse's Nouveau Marche next Tuesday at a price to be set between 152 francs and 225 francs a share, the company's founders say. (Reuter)
BRAND NAME PRODUCTS & MARKETS:

PARIS - Food group Danone expects a rise in sales and improved results this year, chairman Franck Riboud says. The company aims to lead in all its segments, either alone or through acquisitions or alliances. (Reuter)

PARIS - Carmaker Renault says it will create a subsidiary, Renault France Automobiles, in July to run its 77 French dealerships. The move is designed to accelerate the dealers' response-time to market shifts and their return to profit. (Reuter)
Paris Editorial, Sue Landau
For further information and news, see Reuters Advertising & Media Briefing. And visit us on the Internet at http://www.Bizinfo.reuters.com
